<div class="card-body">
'''Sai'torr Kal Fas''' is a [[Light]] [[Effect]] from [[The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)|The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">サイトア・カルファス</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">戦士ではないキャラクター（ドロイドを除く）に配備すると、戦士技能［戦士アイコン］を与える。または戦士に配備すると、戦闘力＋1（「意識操作」カードの影響を受けない）。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-ESB-Two-Player-Saitorr-Kal-Fas-SWCA-100709.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">惑星ダークティル出身のサウリンの女性。同族のドロイド商人ハーチェクのボディーガード。サイトアは、それに見合うと判断した者に、戦闘技能を教える。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Sai'torr Kal Fas.

'''Card text:'''
Deploy on a non-warrior character (except a droid) to give that character warrior skill. Or deploy on a warrior for power +1. (Not affected by the “Mind Manipulation” card.).

'''Lore:'''
A Saurin woman from the planet Durkteel. She is the bodyguard of Hrchek, a Saurin droid trader. Sai’torr teaches combat skills to those she judges worthy.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' 「意識操作」 vs Alter.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Sai'torr Kal Fas]] in [[The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 45, 106. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
